FN-D5QSNTN-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 140
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development Sponsor: Senator Garlan Gudger
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/21/2024
Senate Bill 140 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Alabama Professional Bail
Bonding Board until October 1, 2025 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not
otherwise affect state or local funding.

Senate Bill 140
Committee: ENACTED Sponsor: Senator Garlan Gudger

Professional Bail Bonding Board until October 1, 2025 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law.
